get.summary: Get Disqus user profile for a forum

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of groups with optional filtering and ordering. No route-level middleware enforcement; requires valid OAuth2 bearer token only.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter criteria. Supported filters: slug== (exact match). Example: filter=slug==administrators

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Ordering criteria. Supported fields: id, name, slug. Use + for ascending, - for descending. Example: +name or -id

412.description: Validation failed, invalid filter or order parameter

get.summary: Get Rocket Chat user profile for a forum.
get.description: Returns Rocket Chat user profile data for the authenticated user in the context of the specified forum. The content of the response is defined by "data" portion of the Rocket Chat login endpoint response structure

200.description: OK, returns Rocket Chat user profile data on login success

get.summary: Get Stream Chat user profile for a forum
get.description: Returns the Stream Chat user profile and authentication token for the given forum. Requires SSO scope.
